changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO USER_ATTRIBUTE (id, name, value, user_id) SELECT UUID(), 'markBrandId', rb.BRAND_ID, u.id FROM USER_ENTITY u JOIN REALM_BRAND rb ON rb.REALM_ID = u.REALM_ID AND rb.IS_DEFAULT = 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM USER_ATTRIBUTE a WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND a.name = 'markBrandId');

changeSet.sql: UPDATE USER_POST up JOIN USER_ENTITY ue ON up.USER_ID=ue.ID JOIN REALM_BRAND rb ON rb.REALM_ID=ue.REALM_ID AND rb.IS_DEFAULT=1 SET up.MARK_BRAND_ID=rb.BRAND_ID WHERE up.MARK_BRAND_ID IS NULL;
